title: Cubana de Aviación 1216
summary: Cubana de Aviación Flight 1216 operating a McDonnell Douglas DC-10 overran the runway at La Aurora International Airport on 21 December 1999 while landing on a wet runway. The aircraft touched down too far along the wet runway with insufficient deceleration and the crew failed to initiate a go-around, causing the aircraft to run off the runway end down a slope and crash into residential houses, killing 18 people including all three flight crew members and 2 people on the ground.
probable_cause: The aircraft touched down too far along the wet runway with insufficient deceleration, and the crew failed to initiate a go-around.

events.text: After a two-hour flight, the aircraft was cleared to land on Runway 19 at La Aurora International Airport
Aircraft touched down too far along the runway during landing approach
The pilots were unable to stop the aircraft and it ran off the end of the runway and down a slope
Aircraft crashed into ten houses in La Libertad neighborhood, killing 8 passengers, 8 crew members, and 2 people on the ground
